  135: Despite the exclusion of Gmu ~ 10^{-4}, the string-PBH-LRD connection merits precise quantification. I recommend:

  139: The user claims Gmu ~ 10^{-4} is computed from F_J and M_KK with zero free parameters. The standard formula for cosmic string tension from a symmetry-breaking phase transition at scale eta is:

  142:

  144: 
  145: $$Gmu \sim \left(\frac{7.5 \times 10^{16}}{2.4 \times 10^{18}}\right)^2 \sim \left(\frac{1}{32}\right)^2 \sim 10^{-3}$$
